mentions.name: Lectronz
mentions.description: An online marketplace for electronic enthusiasts and professionals focused on the open-hardware and DIY electronics communities. It features "Threshold Pre-Orders," a pre-order mechanism that lets hardware creators gauge market demand before committing to production or PCBA, which has been successfully tested on four low-volume products.
mentions.problem: Hardware creators need a way to gauge market demand before committing to production/PCBA costs.
mentions.audience: Electronic enthusiasts and professionals in the open-hardware and DIY electronics communities; hardware creators launching low-volume products
mentions.source_excerpt:
I'm continuously building and improving https://lectronz.com/, a marketplace for electronic enthusiasts and professionals that focuses on the open-hardware and DIY electronics communities. 
We recently introduced "Threshold Pre-Orders," a pre-order mechanism that lets hardware creators gauge the market before committing to production/PCBA. 
We have successfully tested this on four low-volume products already.
